creatures.naming_note: 四階段統一命名；青銅門環化作四足幼牛雙角。
creatures.dex_zh: 四足圓鈍的青銅幼牛肩上貼著浮雕翼板，額間嵌有微溫門環。牠穩穩守在夥伴身前，見敵靠近便以蝕紋銳角向前頂撞。
creatures.dex_en: A stout four-legged bronze calf bearing relief wing-plates on its shoulders and a warm gate-ring on its brow.

creatures.naming_note: 四階段統一命名；四足翼刃展開，抽象門扉裝甲成形。
creatures.dex_zh: 雙翼由層層青銅羽片鍛成，胸甲刻滿楔形護符。牠守住陣線要衝，振動金屬翼片向四周拋灑銳利碎鐵。
creatures.dex_en: Forged bronze wing-blades unfold from its shoulders while cuneiform talismans line its breastplate. Anchoring the vanguard, it rattles its metal pinions to scatter razor scrap.

creatures.naming_note: 四階段統一命名；四足青銅翼牛鎮守城門。
creatures.dex_zh: 巍峨的四足青銅翼牛如移動城門般矗立戰場，雙翼垂落如城牆垛口。牠與敵拉開距離後，引動巨型鐵砧般的高壓重擊鎮壓全場。
creatures.dex_en: A towering four-legged bronze winged bull standing like a living citadel gate, dropping an anvil-weight kinetic slam at range.

creatures.naming_note: 四階段統一命名；檳榔花苞纏繞幼蛇頭冠。
creatures.dex_zh: 翠綠幼蛇頸側生出嫩白花苞與細鬚，性格謹慎而敏銳。牠盤踞在隊伍周邊，藉柔韌木刺朝近身敵人疾刺。
creatures.dex_en: A cautious emerald serpentling crowned with pale betel buds and slender tendrils. Coiling near its companions, it lashes out with supple wooden splinters at close threats.

creatures.naming_note: 四階段統一命名；花環藤蔓沿鱗脊攀附。
creatures.dex_zh: 修長蛇軀纏滿綻放的茉莉與蓮葉藤蔓，尾端如濕地長鞭。牠沉著地守住陣腳，甩出帶刺藤索將來犯者牢牢纏縛。
creatures.dex_en: Flowering jasmine and lotus vines twine along its lithe serpent spine down to a marsh-whip tail. Holding steady, it flings thorny snares to bind encroaching foes.

creatures.naming_note: 四階段統一命名；七首蓮冠化作古樹龍威。
creatures.dex_zh: 七瓣玉蓮冠冕盛放於巨蛇額首，周身藤木與翡翠鱗甲交織成林。牠在安全距離外喚起蒼穹巨木轟然砸落。
creatures.dex_en: A seven-petaled jade lotus crowns this regal wyrm, its emerald scales woven with ancient boughs. From afar, it summons colossal timber to crash down upon rivals.

creatures.naming_note: 四階段統一命名；象牙白幼鯨額頭浮現鹽晶紋。
creatures.dex_zh: 通體象牙白的幼鯨在淺浪間游弋，尾鰭帶起細碎水花。牠小心翼翼護在隊友身側，以激流短衝擊退逼近的威脅。
creatures.dex_en: An ivory-white whale calf gliding through shallow swells with sparkling fin spray. Staying guarded beside allies, it jabs forward with a crisp cascade of seawater.

creatures.naming_note: 四階段統一命名；背鰭纏繞斷裂捕鯨繩索與鹽霜。
creatures.dex_zh: 巨鯨額頭刻著風暴疤痕，背鰭纏繞著舊時代的銅製標槍與海藻。牠一旦鎖定獵物便捲起暗流，毫無畏懼地正面衝鋒。
creatures.dex_en: Storm-scarred brow and bronze harpoon lines tangled around its dorsal fin mark this fierce cetacean. Locking onto a target, it rides a surging undertow straight into battle.

creatures.naming_note: 四階段統一命名；白鯨破浪，漩渦翻湧。
creatures.dex_zh: 如移動冰山般的象牙白巨鯨統領深海怒潮，體側鹽晶脊柱閃耀幽藍光輝。牠張口吞吐海嘯旋渦，以排山倒海之勢撞碎敵陣。
creatures.dex_en: A mountain-sized white leviathan commanding abyssal tides, its salt-crystal ridge glowing deep blue. It unleashes a maelstrom tsunami charge that shatters entire formations.

creatures.naming_note: 四階段統一命名；樹皮甲片下藏著跳動炭火。
creatures.dex_zh: 覆著粗糙紅木甲片的幼蜥腹中懷著暖橘火種，呼吸時鼻尖冒出細小火星。牠守在營地邊緣，對迫近者噴出灼熱火花。
creatures.dex_en: Rough redwood armor shields the warm ember heart inside this cautious hatchling. Guarding the camp perimeter, it snaps sparks at anything venturing too close.

creatures.naming_note: 四階段統一命名；背脊木瘤化作熔岩爐口。
creatures.dex_zh: 粗壯的火蜥背部隆起猴麵包樹幹般的耐熱岩甲，縫隙透出暗紅餘燼。牠穩守中線，揮動燒紅的利爪劈出烈焰裂痕。
creatures.dex_en: Baobab-thick heatproof plates rise along its back, glowing with banked embers between cracks. Holding the center, it slashes with white-hot claws trailing cinders.

creatures.naming_note: 四階段統一命名；巨木化灶，火山口生於背脊。
creatures.dex_zh: 宛如行走的古樹熔爐，厚實樹皮與玄武岩甲保護著體內永不熄滅的聖火。牠在後方穩立陣腳，令火山口驟然噴發焚盡四野。
creatures.dex_en: A walking monolith of ancient bark and basalt housing an undying hearth-flame. Anchored at range, it triggers a caldera eruption that engulfs the battlefield.

creatures.naming_note: 四階段統一命名；短玉石角與蓮瓣領甲成形。
creatures.dex_zh: 結合巨犀獨角與蓮瓣浮雕頸甲的砂岩幼獸，四足踩著碎石滑行自如。牠性格好戰果決，低頭便踏碎石塊疾衝向前。
creatures.dex_en: A sandstone rhino cub wearing a lotus-carved collar and short jade horn, skimming over gravel to charge head-on.

creatures.naming_note: 四階段統一命名；廊柱肩甲與修長玉石角伸展。
creatures.dex_zh: 花崗岩廊柱覆滿雙肩，顎側生出弧形玉石角刃，如神殿門柱般威嚴。牠踏步震裂地表，沿斷層線發動猛烈突襲。
creatures.dex_en: Temple-carved granite columns armor its shoulders while curved jade horns cleave the fault line in fierce dashes.

creatures.naming_note: 四階段統一命名；神殿千柱石犀鎮壓地脈。
creatures.dex_zh: 背負千柱神殿浮雕與黃金寶輪的巨型石犀，額前雙重玉石長角凝聚大地岩脈之力，在遠處轟出貫穿戰線的岩層長槍。
creatures.dex_en: A colossal temple-carved rhino bearing golden wheel reliefs, hurling bedrock lances channeled from subterranean veins.

creatures.naming_note: 四階段統一命名；木製雪橇滑板與冰標浮筒結合。
creatures.dex_zh: 圓滾的極地小獸腹下貼著流線冰橇板，頭頂插著紅白航海測標。牠膽小卻靈活，遇敵時貼著冰面高速滑行閃避。
creatures.dex_en: A round polar buoy-creature riding twin sled runners beneath a red-and-white survey mast. Shy yet nimble, it glides swiftly across glazed ice to evade danger.

creatures.naming_note: 四階段統一命名；圓弧木船殼包覆耐壓冰甲。
creatures.dex_zh: 船首破冰刃從胸前延伸而出，兩側木質舷板覆著厚實霜晶。牠迎著暴雪破浪前行，借浮冰撞擊之勢碾開障礙。
creatures.dex_en: An icebreaking prow juts from its chest while frost-rimed timber hulls protect its flanks. Pushing through blizzards, it rams forward with crashing ice-floe momentum.

creatures.naming_note: 四階段統一命名；前進行艦，無懼冰封。
creatures.dex_zh: 如極地探險船般宏偉的冰原巨獸，雙肩聳立著桅杆與測風冰翼。牠無懼最酷烈的極夜狂嵐，領著雪崩般的寒潮一路破冰突進。
creatures.dex_en: A grand icebreaker behemoth crowned with frost-rigged masts and anemometer fins. Undaunted by polar gales, it charges ahead at the crest of an avalanche.

creatures.naming_note: 四階段統一命名；幼雛頸間掛著羅盤風標。
creatures.dex_zh: 潔白帶灰羽的信天翁雛鳥總縮在船桅高處張望海霧，爪間繫著細小青銅風標。牠擅長乘著上升氣流輕巧滑步閃躲。
creatures.dex_en: A pale sea-mist fledgling keeping watch from high masts with a tiny bronze wind-vane. Agile on rising drafts, it sidesteps danger on silent air currents.

creatures.naming_note: 四階段統一命名；長翼展開，如十字弓弦拉滿。
creatures.dex_zh: 修長窄翼在濃霧中劃出冷冽氣流，胸前掛著斑駁航海星盤。牠居高臨下俯瞰海面，化作疾風之箭高速突刺。
creatures.dex_en: Long narrow wings slice through sea fog beneath a weathered brass astrolabe. Surveying the swells from above, it darts downward like a cyclone bolt.

creatures.naming_note: 四階段統一命名；跨洋巨翼，御風不墜。
creatures.dex_zh: 雙翼展開足有數丈寬的遠洋風靈，羽尖拖曳著半透明雲霧與暴風眼微光。牠盤旋高空拉開距離，揮翼捲起橫掃海天的颶風。
creatures.dex_en: A pelagic sovereign whose vast wings trail translucent mist and storm-eye glints. Soaring high out of reach, it sweeps its pinions to unleash a horizon-wide hurricane.

creatures.naming_note: 四階段統一命名；沙漠赤蟲體節閃爍靜電微光。
creatures.dex_zh: 暗紅色沙蟲幼體表面覆著絕緣沙殼，尾端每隔數秒便迸出細小脈衝電環。牠潛行於沙丘側翼，謹慎試探周遭動靜。
creatures.dex_en: A crimson sand-larva sheathed in insulating grit, pulsing tiny static rings from its tail. Flanking across dunes, it probes threats cautiously with electric ripples.

creatures.naming_note: 四階段統一命名；口器化作雙極電弧線圈。
creatures.dex_zh: 體節膨脹為赤銅色高壓電容環，口器張開時跳躍著藍紫電弧。牠穩踞沙窩陣地，朝逼近之敵連續釋放高壓放電。
creatures.dex_en: Segmented copper capacitor rings line its body while blue-violet arcs crackle between its mandibles. Holding its sand-pit ground, it fires chained arc discharges.

creatures.naming_note: 四階段統一命名；戈壁赤煞，電磁貫日。
creatures.dex_zh: 盤踞荒漠地平線的赤紅雷龍蟲，背脊排列著結晶化的磁軌線圈。牠在遠處蓄積熾烈電漿，沿直線轟出貫穿砂岩的電磁雷砲。
creatures.dex_en: An apex desert voltwyrm whose spine bristles with crystallized rail-coils. Charging plasma from afar, it fires a blinding electromagnetic rail-beam across the sands.

creatures.naming_note: 四階段統一命名；微光金箔折疊成精巧多面體。
creatures.dex_zh: 像懸浮折紙金箔般的光屬性小精靈，核心閃耀著暖白粒子微光。牠性格害羞卻專注，遇近敵便折射出一道銳利光刺。
creatures.dex_en: A floating origami-gold sprite housing a warm white core of dancing particles. Shy yet focused, it refracts a crisp glint of light at anything drawing near.

creatures.naming_note: 四階段統一命名；雙重金箔環帶繞核高速旋轉。
creatures.dex_zh: 薄如蟬翼的金箔稜鏡環繞中央核球旋轉，散射出細密光譜軌跡。牠守在陣列後方，將散射光束聚斂為精準的光學長槍。
creatures.dex_en: Paper-thin gold-foil prisms orbit a central luminous nucleus, scattering spectral trails. Guarding the rear, it focuses scattered beams into a piercing optic lance.

creatures.naming_note: 四階段統一命名；千層金箔散射極光扇陣。
creatures.dex_zh: 層層嵌套的精密金箔環陣宛如微型迴旋加速器，中央核心綻放太陽般的純淨光輝。牠在遠距展開扇形光譜，將來襲衝擊全數折射反彈。
creatures.dex_en: Concentric gold-foil rings spin like a living cyclotron around a radiant sun-core. From range, it fans out chromatic rays that dazzle and deflect incoming force.

creatures.naming_note: 四階段統一命名；極北小貂熊披上啞光玄鐵細甲。
creatures.dex_zh: 披著啞光黑鐵細甲的極北幼貂熊，肩頸垂落如夜間寒煙般的暗毛。牠善於繞行敵陣側翼，乘暮色掩護以暗影利爪突襲。
creatures.dex_en: A northern wolverine kit clad in matte black-iron plates, slipping along flanks under dusk cover with shadow-edged claws.

creatures.naming_note: 四階段統一命名；寒鐵弧刃護甲與幽影披風尾展開。
creatures.dex_zh: 胸甲與護額鑄成寒鐵弧刃的玄鐵貂熊，潛伏衝刺時身後拖出數道半透明幽影殘像，發動令敵防不勝防的突襲。
creatures.dex_en: Armored with forged black-iron crescents, this prowling wolverine trails translucent twilight afterimages on every lunge.

creatures.naming_note: 四階段統一命名；重裝玄鐵巨貂熊鎮守極夜邊界。
creatures.dex_zh: 身披繁枝巨樹紋玄鐵重鎧的極寒巨貂熊，披風般的幽影長尾隨寒風獵獵作響，化作無聲黑鐵疾風貫穿敵陣。
creatures.dex_en: An iron-armored shadow wolverine whose dark mantle-tail ripples in freezing winds, cleaving vanguards with phantom speed.

moves.desc_zh: 壓低青銅雙角，以帶蝕刻紋路的金屬銳鋒向前短距頂撞。
moves.desc_en: Lowers its etched bronze horns to deliver a short-range metallic thrust.

moves.desc_zh: 劇烈振動青銅翼片，向周身近中距離拋灑如雨的銳利碎鐵片。
moves.desc_en: Rattles its bronze wing-blades to scatter a close-range hail of razor scrap.

moves.naming_note: 城門鎮嶽般的重錘落地。
moves.desc_zh: 高舉雙翼凝聚萬鈞玄鐵重壓，朝遠處目標砸下鐵砧般的毀滅震波。
moves.desc_en: Channels monumental bronze mass through its wings to drop an anvil-force shockwave at range.

moves.desc_zh: 繃緊頸側嫩藤，朝前方近距離目標連貫刺出銳利木刺。
moves.desc_en: Tenses its young vines to jab sharp wooden splinters forward at close range.

moves.desc_zh: 甩出盤繞脊背的荊棘花藤，在前方範圍形成纏繞束縛敵人的蔓網。
moves.desc_en: Flings thorny garland vines forward to ensnare targets within a tangled perimeter.

moves.naming_note: 喚起濕地蒼穹巨木砸落。
moves.desc_zh: 自遠方地脈催生參天古木與巨藤，從天而降轟然砸碎敵陣。
moves.desc_en: Summons an ancient bough from distant roots to crash down upon distant rivals.

moves.desc_zh: 拍動尾鰭激起高壓水沫，沿直線向前發動俐落的水流短衝。
moves.desc_en: Slaps its tail fin to surge forward along a brisk, foaming cascade.

moves.desc_zh: 將周身海水化作漩渦暗流包裹身軀，以捕鯨標槍般的銳勢直線衝鋒。
moves.desc_en: Wraps itself in a roaring undertow and charges straight through foes like a harpoon.

moves.desc_zh: 喚起百丈深海巨浪與鹽晶旋渦，化作不可阻擋的海嘯正面碾壓全場。
moves.desc_en: Rides a towering wall of abyssal seawater and salt-crystal eddies to crush the battlefield.

moves.desc_zh: 張口噴出跳躍的橘紅火星並伴隨短距撲咬，灼傷近身目標。
moves.desc_en: Snaps forward with crackling orange sparks bursting from its armored jaws.

moves.desc_zh: 引燃體內爐火覆於前爪，朝前方弧形揮劈出殘留灼熱餘燼的烈焰爪痕。
moves.desc_en: Ignites its claws with furnace heat to carve a sweeping arc of burning cinders.

moves.desc_zh: 打開背脊厚重樹皮岩甲下的火山口，向遠處區域傾瀉高溫熔岩爆炎。
moves.desc_en: Opens the caldera vents along its back to rain searing volcanic blasts across distant ground.

moves.desc_zh: 踩踏砂岩滑板順著地脈隆起高速滑行，沿直線衝撞前方敵人。
moves.desc_en: Skates swiftly over raised sandstone slabs to ram targets straight ahead.

moves.desc_zh: 雙足猛踏震開裂隙，順著斷層衝擊波的軌道猛烈突刺。
moves.desc_en: Splits the earth underfoot and surges down the fault-line shockwave.

moves.naming_note: 神殿石柱化作地脈長槍。
moves.desc_zh: 在遠處引動深層岩盤劇烈隆起，刺出如神殿巨柱般的銳利岩石長槍。
moves.desc_en: Raises deep bedrock plates from afar into a colossal, piercing stone lance.

moves.desc_zh: 壓低身軀貼著凝結的鏡面薄冰高速滑行，撞擊路徑上的目標。
moves.desc_en: Drops low onto its ice-sled runners to glide swiftly into targets along a slick path.

moves.desc_zh: 推進船首破冰厚刃正面衝鋒，將沿途碎冰如浪般撞向敵群。
moves.desc_en: Drives its icebreaker prow forward, hurling shattered floes into opposing ranks.

moves.desc_zh: 掀起鋪天蓋地的極地雪崩狂潮，以極限破冰之勢長距突進碾碎前路。
moves.desc_en: Commands a thundering polar avalanche, charging across the field behind an unstoppable prow.

moves.desc_zh: 扇動細小海霧翼羽捲起上升氣流，靈巧貼近並以風壓掠擊目標。
moves.desc_en: Catches a brisk updraft on mist-tipped wings to skim forward and buffet foes.

moves.desc_zh: 將長翼收束成十字弓箭矢狀，包裹在高速氣旋中沿直線疾射突刺。
moves.desc_en: Folds its long wings into a crossbow-bolt silhouette and darts forward inside a tight cyclone.

moves.desc_zh: 在遠距離高空展開巨翼橫掃，喚起吞沒海平線的猛烈颶風環流。
moves.desc_en: Sweeps its vast pelagic wings from high altitude to unleash a horizon-spanning hurricane.

moves.desc_zh: 震動沙殼體節，向周圍近距離釋放麻痺目標的環狀靜電脈衝。
moves.desc_en: Vibrates its segmented grit shell to emit a stunning ring of static electricity.

moves.naming_note: 雙極電容轟出高壓電弧。
moves.desc_zh: 張開顎部雙極線圈，向前方扇形區域連續轟出跳躍的藍紫電弧。
moves.desc_en: Spreads its bipolar mandibles to unleash jumping arcs of high-voltage plasma ahead.

moves.naming_note: 戈壁赤龍貫穿天際的磁軌砲。
moves.desc_zh: 鎖定遠方目標後沿脊背磁軌加速電漿，轟出撕裂荒漠的直線雷光砲。
moves.desc_en: Accelerates superheated plasma along its dorsal rail-coils into a blistering linear beam.

moves.desc_zh: 調整金箔切面角度，向近前方瞬間射出一道聚斂的銳利閃光。
moves.desc_en: Tilts its gold-foil facets to snap a focused flash of light straight ahead.

moves.desc_zh: 令雙重金箔環帶同步對焦，沿直線向遠處貫穿射出純淨光學長槍。
moves.desc_en: Aligns its twin foil rings to project a razor-sharp optic lance across the field.

moves.naming_note: 千層金箔展開光譜扇陣。
moves.desc_zh: 高速旋轉迴旋光環並展開金箔扇面，向遠方區域傾瀉七彩高能光束。
moves.desc_en: Spins its cyclotron rings to fan out a dazzling barrage of chromatic light beams at range.

moves.desc_zh: 融入地面的狹長影子之中疾步迫近，以附著寒鐵微光的暗影利齒啃咬。
moves.desc_en: Slips through lengthening dusk shadows to lunge with cold iron-edged fangs.

moves.desc_zh: 身形化作半透明幽影閃爍加速，沿直線無聲穿透敵方防線。
moves.desc_en: Phases into translucent twilight afterimages, dashing silently straight through defenses.

moves.desc_zh: 披風般的暗影長鬃狂舞，化身重甲幽靈鐵騎發動貫穿全場的直線衝鋒。
moves.desc_en: Billowing a cloak of dark mist, it charges straight across the battlefield like a phantom knight.

traits.desc_zh: 金屬機關與城門軸承分毫不差，提升防禦穩定度與準確度。
花冠與藤蔓持續汲取濕地生機，在戰局中緩慢修復受損甲殼。
周身流轉的潔淨海潮能沖刷異常狀態與焦灼塵垢。
體表散逸的熾熱餘燼形成護幕，削弱遠距突襲帶來的衝擊。
如山崩岩柱般的厚重慣性，使每一次突進都伴隨震懾地鳴。
船首與冰刃帶著極地嚴寒，觸及目標時使其動作凝滯。
乘著高空氣流盤旋警戒，大幅提升閃避遠距襲擊的反應速度。
體內高壓電容在乾燥沙地中更易導通，延伸電弧攻擊的有效距離。
環繞身軀的金箔稜鏡能偏折部分正面光熱與能量衝擊。
在極夜與暮色中融入環境陰影，降低移動時被鎖定的機率。
